title: What lies outside the count?
hook: An original counting rule includes one class of events and can exclude every target.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to locate the excluded class before interpreting a count as complete awareness

misconception: A complete count within one event class establishes that no important excluded event occurred.
objective: Locate the excluded class before interpreting a count as complete awareness.
